exec bash -lc 's="${CODEX_HOME:-$HOME/.codex}/sessions"; [ -d "$s" ] || exit 3; f=$(find -H "$s" -type f -name "rollout-*.jsonl" -newer "$1" | while read -r f; do m=$(head -n 1 "$f"); printf "%s" "$m" | grep -qF -e "\"cwd\":\"$1\"" -e "\"cwd\": \"$1\"" && ! printf "%s" "$m" | grep -qF "\"parent_thread_id\"" && { printf "%s\n" "$f"; break; }; done); [ -n "$f" ] && exec cat -- "$f"; exit 3' skill-probe /home/codex-bot/factory-work/jobs/job-1/repo
